description: Author-created fixed English corpus for English MiniLM; no external labels or precomputed embeddings. All text fits one chunk.

documents.text: seekdb stores document text, metadata and vectors. Hybrid search combines semantic vector similarity with full text keyword ranking inside the database.
WebGPU executes neural network inference on the local graphics processor in a browser. No cloud inference service is required.
WebAssembly is a portable CPU inference backend. When WebGPU is unavailable the browser can automatically fall back to WASM.
INT8 quantization represents model weights with eight bit integers instead of float32 values, reducing download size and memory requirements.
Batch processing embeds multiple documents in one inference call. It improves throughput by reducing per call overhead.
After incremental document writes refresh the seekdb vector index before searching for the newly imported content.
Local embedding keeps inference on the user device. The application sends document text, metadata and computed vectors to the local seekdb database.
The browser caches downloaded model files. A warm model load reuses cached weights instead of downloading the model again.
Recall at K measures the fraction of relevant documents retrieved among the top K search results. NDCG also rewards correct ranking order.
